title: Compat API v1.49: image inspect platform and FirewallBackend
body:
Docker Engine API [v1.49](https://docs.docker.com/reference/api/engine/version-history/#v149-api-changes) still has two Compat gaps before we can treat 1.49 as covered under the parent epic (claim v1.55).
## Needs work
### 1. `GET /images/{name}/json?platform=`
- Accept a JSON-encoded OCI platform query parameter to select a platform from a multi-platform image.
- Mutually exclusive with experimental `manifests`.
- Today Compat inspect does not parse `platform` and looks up the image without platform options.
### 2. `GET /info` `FirewallBackend`
- Return `FirewallBackend` (`Driver` + optional `Info`) describing firewalling configuration.
- Applicable via Podman/netavark `Network.FirewallDriver` (e.g. nftables/iptables); not a Docker-only concept.
## Checklist
- [ ] `GET /images/{name}/json?platform=`
- [ ] `GET /info` `FirewallBackend`
## Contributing
If you want to work on one checklist item, please open a focused issue and PR for that part and reference **this** issue (and the parent epic). Prefer one change area per PR.
